verdict.rationale: The CLI's own `skills init [name]` command scaffolds a new SKILL.md template, which is a first-party starting point for authoring. An install example also names a `skill-creator` skill in vercel-labs/agent-skills, but nothing in the evidence describes what it does or whether it guides an agent through writing, improving, or packaging. missing for 10: documented meta-skill behavior that guides the agent through authoring, iterative improvement/refinement guidance, packaging or publishing workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection ships a meta-skill or tool that guides my agent through writing, improving, and packaging new skills
